mapper.select: SELECT a.*, , p.name as patient_name, d.name as doctor_name, d.title as doctor_title, dept.dept_name, s.clinic_room FROM appointment a LEFT JOIN patient p ON a.patient_id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON a.doctor_id = d.doctor_id LEFT JOIN department dept ON a.dept_id = dept.dept_id LEFT JOIN schedule s ON a.schedule_id = s.schedule_id WHERE a.appt_id = #{apptId} AND a.deleted = 0
